notes: Manufacturer's own site/data sheet file names this product "125e" (page 125e.html, data sheet pdf/125e-data.pdf) but the data sheet's printed model designation is "125EE" — the current "Enhanced²" revision of what was originally the 125E; DFD's Splitter Selection Matrix also lists "125 Enhanced" as a distinct line from the base 123/125/1211 splitters. Treated here as the same product the query refers to as "125E." It is a 1-input/5-output DMX512 optically-isolated splitter/amplifier (not an AV signal device); category/type fields are approximations since no lighting-control-specific category exists in the schema. Physical size is 1.74"H x 11.25"D x 8.25"W (not full 19" rack width); it mounts via an accessory rack kit (RK 8-1 for one unit, RK 8-2 for two units side by side), hence rackUnits set to 1. No bandwidth "grade" applies to any port (DMX512/EIA-485 is not one of the graded connector families). Power connector is described only as "IEC-320 (international) input connector" with no C13/C14 distinction stated, mapped to the generic "iec" id.
